description: 農作物災害種類別被害統計(被害応急調査結果 [disaster risk and hazard maps] (series on data.go.jp) is a series of datasets listed in Data Catalog Site of the Japanese government (data.go.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農林水産省. 農作物に重大な被害が発生した場合に、地方交付税のうち特別交付税の算定、天災融資法等の適用、その他災害対策の企画・立案、実施等の資料を速やかに作成することを目的とする。. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 農林水産省. Its tags are 統計, 統計調査結果, 農業_林業. It offers 54 resource(s) in pdf, xls. The portal shows 2023-05-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-datago-portal.
